use: Templates show layout, composition, hierarchy and rhythm only. Never copy their text, numbers, claims, client names or logos: content comes from the user. Their colours, fonts and sizes need not match the design system; build every output with design-system tokens, text roles, components and assets. Pick the template whose structure fits the user's content, then adapt it.
source: Figma Design MCP, the Template frame on the outcome's page

sections.name: Posts
sections.use: Single posts, square and portrait together. For layout and feel only; every post uses the design system.

templates.name: Case study cover · photo
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. A plant photo full bleed under a dark overlay; an eyebrow tag and logo at the top; a large headline with the second part in the accent colour; a translucent box with a one-line summary; a 'swipe' CTA pill bottom-right.

templates.name: Step · big stat with icon flow
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. Step eyebrow and logo at the top; a giant stat with a two-line label; a row of icons converging into one pill (the flow); a dark caption box at the bottom.

templates.name: Step · before and after bars
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. Step eyebrow; a big stat with label; a before and after comparison as two labelled bars; a dark caption box at the bottom.

templates.name: Step · before and after chart
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. Step eyebrow; a big stat with label; a before and after line chart (a wild line settling into a steady band); a caption box and a footnote.

templates.name: Results · stat tiles
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. Logo and a results tag at the top; a 2x2 grid of stat tiles (one highlighted in brand blue); a closing line and a website pill at the bottom.

templates.name: Step · stat with gauge
templates.layout: Portrait 4:5. Logo; step eyebrow; a big stat with label and a short paragraph; a gauge dial chart showing the change; a footnote.

sections.name: Carousel (1:1)
sections.use: A square multi-slide post: cover slide, content slides and a closing slide.

templates.name: Cover · Bruce AI product post
templates.layout: Square 1:1. Bruce AI posts only: the headline uses gradient/bruce-ai; a short subline; an outlined CTA; a product visual at the bottom right; website bottom-left. Glow is approved on Bruce AI posts: keep the glowing product visual.

templates.name: Content · quote with headshot
templates.layout: Square 1:1. A plant photo background; a dark quote card with one highlighted phrase, the speaker's name and role, and a button; the speaker's round headshot overlapping the card bottom-right; logo top-left, website top-right.
